<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Larp.lol</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20200%20200%22%20width%3D%22512%22%20height%3D%22512%22%3E%20%20%3Ctitle%3ELarp.lol%3C/title%3E%20%20%3Crect%20width%3D%22200%22%20height%3D%22200%22%20fill%3D%22%23000%22/%3E%20%20%3Cdefs%3E%20%20%20%20%3CclipPath%20id%3D%22over%22%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%22146.2%22%20cy%3D%22100%22%20r%3D%2211%22/%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%2276.9%22%20cy%3D%2260%22%20r%3D%2211%22/%3E%3Ccircle%20cx%3D%2276.9%22%20cy%3D%22140%22%20r%3D%2211%22/%3E%3C/clipPath%3E%20%20%3C/defs%3E%20%20%3Cg%20fill%3D%22none%22%20stroke-linejoin%3D%22miter%22%20stroke-miterlimit%3D%2210%22%3E%20%20%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M100%2020%20L169.28%20140%20L30.72%20140%20Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23fff%22%20stroke-width%3D%227%22/%3E%20%20%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M100%20180%20L30.72%2060%20L169.28%2060%20Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23000%22%20stroke-width%3D%2215%22/%3E%20%20%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M100%20180%20L30.72%2060%20L169.28%2060%20Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23fff%22%20stroke-width%3D%227%22/%3E%20%20%20%20%3Cg%20clip-path%3D%22url%28%23over%29%22%3E%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M100%2020%20L169.28%20140%20L30.72%20140%20Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23000%22%20stroke-width%3D%2215%22/%3E%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M100%2020%20L169.28%20140%20L30.72%20140%20Z%22%20stroke%3D%22%23fff%22%20stroke-width%3D%227%22/%3E%20%20%20%20%3C/g%3E%20%20%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@600;800&family=Space+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#000; --fg:#fff; --dim:rgba(var(--fgc),.45); --line:rgba(var(--fgc),.28);
  --display:'Unbounded','Arial Black',Impact,sans-serif;
  --mono:'Space Mono',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  color-scheme:dark; box-sizing:border-box; --fgc:255,255,255; --r:0px;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);height:100%}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
body{height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--display);-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.scan{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(var(--fgc),.035) 0 1px,transparent 1px 4px);mix-blend-mode:screen}
.vig{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 40%,#000 100%)}
.stage{position:fixed;inset:0;cursor:pointer;outline:none}

/* logo */
.logo{position:absolute;left:50%;top:26%;width:clamp(150px,27vh,250px);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);will-change:transform;pointer-events:none}
.logo svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.star{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(var(--fgc),.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(var(--fgc),.25));animation:float 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.ring1{transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:spin 28s linear infinite}
.ring2{transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:spin 40s linear infinite reverse}
.pulse{transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:pulse 3.2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes pulse{0%{transform:scale(.7);opacity:.6}100%{transform:scale(1.35);opacity:0}}

/* title + prompt */
.title{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:56%;transform:translateY(-50%);text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,12vw,6.2rem);letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1;transition:opacity .5s,transform .6s}
.title span{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.title span::before,.title span::after{content:attr(data-t);position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.title span::before{transform:translateX(-4px);clip-path:inset(0 0 62% 0);animation:g1 3.4s steps(1) infinite;opacity:.85}
.title span::after{transform:translateX(4px);clip-path:inset(60% 0 0 0);animation:g2 3.4s steps(1) infinite;opacity:.85}
@keyframes g1{0%,88%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}90%{transform:translateX(-7px)}94%{transform:translateX(5px)}}
@keyframes g2{0%,91%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}93%{transform:translateX(8px)}97%{transform:translateX(-5px)}}
.prompt{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(11% + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:1rem;color:var(--dim);transition:opacity .4s}
.prompt b{font-weight:400;color:var(--fg);animation:blink 1.4s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.15}}
.entered .title{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-50%) scale(.94)}
.entered .prompt{opacity:0}
.entered .stage{cursor:default}

/* menu */
.menu{position:absolute;left:50%;top:27%;width:min(92vw,620px);transform:translateX(-50%);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;list-style:none;padding:0;pointer-events:none}
.menu.live{pointer-events:auto}
.tile{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;height:clamp(92px,15vh,130px);padding:14px 16px;text-align:left;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;--mx:50%;--my:50%;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-40px);clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transition:opacity .5s,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),clip-path .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),border-color .25s,box-shadow .35s}
.menu.live .tile{opacity:1;transform:none;clip-path:inset(0);transition-delay:calc(var(--i)*.08s),calc(var(--i)*.08s),calc(var(--i)*.08s),0s,0s}
.tile::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(240px circle at var(--mx) var(--my),rgba(var(--fgc),.22),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tile::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--fg),transparent);transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.menu.live .tile:hover,.menu.live .tile:focus-visible{border-color:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 36px rgba(var(--fgc),.16);outline:none}
.tile:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tile:hover::after{transform:translateX(100%)}
.tt{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}
.ic{width:34px;height:34px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);transition:background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s}
.ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.tile:hover .ic{background:var(--fg);color:#000;border-color:var(--fg)}
.ar{width:20px;height:20px;opacity:0;transform:translate(-6px,6px) rotate(-45deg);transition:opacity .3s,transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.tile:hover .ar{opacity:1;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.tb{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.tn{font:700 clamp(1.15rem,3.4vh,1.5rem)/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.045em}
.td{font:.72rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim);transition:color .25s}
.tile:hover .td{color:var(--fg)}
.tile:active{background:rgba(var(--fgc),.12)}

[hidden]{display:none!important}
.brand{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(11% + clamp(37px,6.75vh,62px) + 10px);text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(1.3rem,4vh,1.8rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px);clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transition:opacity .6s,transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),clip-path .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1);pointer-events:none}
.brand.live{opacity:1;transform:none;clip-path:inset(0)}
.menu.away{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s}
.view{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 40% at 50% -8%,rgba(var(--fgc),.12),transparent 70%),#000;clip-path:circle(0 at var(--cx,50%) var(--cy,50%));visibility:hidden;transition:clip-path .9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1),visibility 0s .9s}
.view.open{clip-path:circle(150vmax at var(--cx,50%) var(--cy,50%));visibility:visible;transition-delay:0s}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(105%);opacity:0}}
.home{position:absolute;z-index:6;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);left:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:48px;padding:0 20px 0 11px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line);font:.85rem var(--mono);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .3s}
.home svg{width:28px;height:28px;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.home:hover{border-color:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(var(--fgc),.2)}
.home:hover svg{transform:rotate(60deg)}
.home:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.card:focus-visible,.chip:focus-visible,.go:focus-visible,.set summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--fg);outline-offset:3px}
.vtitle{margin:0;padding:84px clamp(18px,5vw,64px) .14em;overflow:hidden;font:800 clamp(3.4rem,14vw,10rem)/.9 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.055em}
.vtitle span{display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--fg) 35%,rgba(var(--fgc),.3));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:rise .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both}
.vsub{margin:4px clamp(18px,5vw,64px) 0;font:1rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim);animation:fade .8s .7s both}
.view.compact .vtitle{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,7vw,3.6rem);padding-top:78px}
.view.compact .vsub,.view.frame .vtitle,.view.frame .vsub{display:none}
.vb{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:clamp(22px,4vh,44px) clamp(18px,5vw,64px) calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#444 transparent}
.view.frame .vb{padding:0}
.vb>*{animation:fade .5s .1s both}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:44px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);color:var(--fg);font:.85rem var(--mono);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}
.btn:hover,.btn.solid{background:var(--fg);color:#000;border-color:var(--fg)}
.btn.solid:hover{background:#000;color:var(--fg)}
input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:0;color:var(--fg);font:inherit}
input:focus{outline:none}
input::placeholder{color:rgba(var(--fgc),.35)}
.go{flex:none;width:64px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--fg);color:#000;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s}
.go svg{width:24px;height:24px;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.go:hover svg{transform:translateX(5px)}
.go:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.chips,.sug{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chip{height:42px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);font:.85rem var(--mono);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s;animation:up .6s calc(.6s + var(--i,0)*.07s) both}
.chip:hover{background:var(--fg);color:#000;border-color:var(--fg)}

.proxy{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px;width:100%;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
.launch{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px}
.search{display:flex;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .4s;animation:up .8s .45s both}
.search:focus-within{border-color:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -24px rgba(var(--fgc),.55)}
.search input{height:84px;padding:0 4px;font:600 clamp(1.3rem,4.5vw,2.3rem) var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.search .go{width:84px}
.note{margin:0;padding-left:14px;border-left:2px solid var(--fg);font:.85rem/1.7 var(--mono);color:var(--dim);animation:fade .4s both}
.stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:auto;font:.8rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--fg);display:inline-block}
.dot.on{background:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--fg)}
.dot.pend{animation:blink 1.2s steps(2) infinite}
.browser{display:none;flex:1;min-height:0;flex-direction:column}
.proxy.browsing{max-width:none;margin:0;gap:0}
.proxy.browsing .launch,.proxy.browsing .stat{display:none}
.proxy.browsing .browser{display:flex}
.mini{display:flex;flex:1;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.mini input{height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);font:.9rem var(--mono)}
.mini input:focus{border-color:var(--fg)}

.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,290px),1fr));gap:14px;width:100%;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}
.card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;min-height:210px;padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;text-align:left;background:rgba(var(--fgc),.025);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .25s;--mx:50%;--my:50%;animation:up .7s calc(.4s + var(--i)*.08s) both}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(280px circle at var(--mx) var(--my),rgba(var(--fgc),.2),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.card:hover{border-color:var(--fg)}
.card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.num{position:absolute;top:-14px;right:10px;z-index:-1;font:800 8.5rem/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.07em;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(var(--fgc),.2);transition:-webkit-text-stroke-color .3s,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.card:hover .num{-webkit-text-stroke-color:rgba(var(--fgc),.75);transform:translateY(10px) scale(1.05)}
.arr{position:absolute;top:22px;left:24px;width:22px;height:22px;opacity:0;transform:translate(-8px,8px);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}
.arr svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.card:hover .arr{opacity:1;transform:none}
.nm{font:700 1.7rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.04em}
.tag{font:.8rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}

.fv{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.fbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;height:72px;flex:none;padding:0 16px 0 150px}
.fbar b{font:700 1.15rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.fbar .h{flex:1;font:.8rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.fbar .btn{margin-left:auto}
.fv iframe,.browser iframe{flex:1;width:100%;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--fg)}
@media (max-width:700px){.fbar .h{display:none}.fbar{padding-left:138px}}

.chat{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;width:100%;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto}
.set{position:absolute;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);right:16px;z-index:6}
.set summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;height:48px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font:.85rem var(--mono);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s}
.set summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.set summary:hover,.set[open] summary{border-color:var(--fg)}
.pop{position:absolute;top:58px;right:0;width:min(88vw,340px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;padding:18px;background:#000;border:1px solid var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(var(--fgc),.12);font:.8rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim);animation:up .3s both}
.pop label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.pop input{flex:none;height:42px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--fg);font:.9rem var(--mono)}
.pop input:focus{border-color:var(--fg)}
.msgs{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;padding:6px 2px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#444 transparent}
.hello{margin:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px;text-align:center}
.hello p{margin:0;font:800 clamp(1.8rem,6vw,3rem) var(--display);letter-spacing:-.05em}
.sug{justify-content:center}
.m{display:flex;gap:14px;max-width:100%;animation:up .45s both}
.m svg{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;margin-top:2px}
.m p{margin:0;font:1rem/1.75 var(--mono);white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.m.u{align-self:flex-end;max-width:82%;background:var(--fg);color:#000;padding:12px 18px}
.m.u p{font-weight:700}
.m p.err{color:var(--dim)}
.m p.live::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:.55em;height:1em;margin-left:3px;vertical-align:-.15em;background:var(--fg);animation:blink 1s steps(2) infinite}
.composer{flex:none;display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:border-color .25s,box-shadow .4s}
.composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(var(--fgc),.14)}
.composer input{height:62px;padding:0 20px;font:1rem var(--mono)}
.composer .go{width:62px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vtitle span,.card,.chip,.search,.m,.pop{animation:none}}
body.no-stars #stars,body.no-scan .scan{display:none}
.calm *,.calm *::before,.calm *::after{animation-duration:.001s!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001s!important}
.tile,.card,.btn,.chip,.home,.composer,.set summary,.pop,.tr .th,.ic,.sg,.mini input,.m.u{border-radius:var(--r)}
.composer{overflow:hidden}

.sl{width:100%;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.opt{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);animation:up .6s calc(.35s + var(--i)*.07s) both}
.opt b{display:block;font:700 1.15rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.opt small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:.8rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.rc{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.sg{height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);font:.82rem var(--mono);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s}
.sg.on,.sg:hover{background:var(--fg);color:#000;border-color:var(--fg)}
.sw{width:54px;height:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;position:relative;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .3s}
.sw::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--dim);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),background .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.sw[aria-checked=true]{border-color:var(--fg)}
.sw[aria-checked=true]::after{transform:translateX(24px);background:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--fg)}
.swatch{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;background:rgb(var(--c));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #000;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.swatch.on{border-color:var(--fg)}
.swatch:hover{transform:scale(1.12)}

@property --a{syntax:'<angle>';initial-value:0deg;inherits:false}
@keyframes ang{to{--a:360deg}}
.dock{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:25;width:min(92vw,440px);height:68px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 1px var(--line);transform:translate(-50%,160%);pointer-events:none;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),width .55s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1)}
.dock.show{transform:translate(-50%,0);pointer-events:auto}
.dock.min{width:68px}
.dock.min>:not(.ring){opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .2s,visibility 0s .3s}
.dock::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;padding:1.5px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--a),transparent 0 60%,var(--fg));-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s;pointer-events:none;animation:ang 3.5s linear infinite}
.dock.play::before{opacity:1}
.ring{flex:none;width:52px;height:52px;padding:3px;border:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;background:conic-gradient(var(--fg) calc(var(--p,0)*1%),rgba(var(--fgc),.18) 0)}
.disc{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background:#000 center/cover}
.dock.play .disc,.bigdisc.spin{animation:spin 8s linear infinite}
.hole{position:absolute;inset:36%;border-radius:50%;background:#000;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--fgc),.5)}
.dinfo{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding-left:2px}
.dinfo b{font:700 .95rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.dinfo span{font:.72rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.eq{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:22px}
.eq i{display:block;width:3px;height:3px;background:var(--fg);transition:height .08s linear}
.dctl{display:flex;flex:none}
.ib{flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.ib svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.ib:hover{background:rgba(var(--fgc),.14)}
.ib.pp{width:42px;height:42px;background:var(--fg);color:#000}
.ib.pp:hover{background:var(--fg);transform:scale(1.08)}
.ib:focus-visible,.ring:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--fg);outline-offset:2px}
@media (max-width:420px){.eq{display:none}}
body.dockon .vb{padding-bottom:calc(104px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
body.dockon .view.frame .vb{padding:0 0 90px}

.mus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,380px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(24px,5vw,64px);width:100%;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:820px){.mus{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:center}
.vis{position:relative;width:min(100%,340px);aspect-ratio:1}
.vis canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.bigdisc{position:absolute;inset:27%;border-radius:50%;background:#000 center/cover;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line),0 0 60px rgba(var(--fgc),.2)}
.mt{margin:6px 0 0;font:800 clamp(1.5rem,4vw,2rem) var(--display);letter-spacing:-.045em}
.ma{margin:0;font:.9rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.seek{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;font:.75rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.sbar{flex:1;height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.sbar b{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;height:3px;background:rgba(var(--fgc),.18)}
.sbar i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:calc(var(--p,0)*1%);background:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--fg)}
.sbar i::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-5px;top:-4px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--fg)}
.bctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bctl .ib{width:52px;height:52px}
.bctl .ib.pp{width:70px;height:70px}
.bctl .ib svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.lh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px;font:700 1.1rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em}
.tl{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.tr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;width:100%;padding:10px;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(var(--fgc),.12);border-left:2px solid transparent;color:var(--fg);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;animation:up .5s calc(.3s + var(--i)*.05s) both}
.tr:hover{background:rgba(var(--fgc),.07)}
.tr.on{background:rgba(var(--fgc),.1);border-left-color:var(--fg)}
.tr .th{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;background:#000 center/cover;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tx{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tx b{display:block;font:600 1rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.03em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tx small{font:.75rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.tr em{font:normal .75rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.foot{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:24;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 14px;font:.72rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim);background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.foot button,.foot a{font:inherit;color:var(--dim);background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.foot button:hover,.foot a:hover,.foot button:focus-visible,.foot a:focus-visible{color:var(--fg);outline:none}
.foot i{font-style:normal;color:var(--line)}
@media (max-width:720px){body.dockon .foot{bottom:calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}}
.vb{padding-bottom:calc(60px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.view.frame .vb{padding:0 0 46px}
.src{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:30px}
.src .card{min-height:104px;padding:16px}
.src .nm{font-size:1.1rem}
.src .arr{top:14px;left:auto;right:14px}
.glow{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--gx,50%) var(--gy,50%),rgba(var(--fgc),.1),transparent 70%)}
.gridbg{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(var(--fgc),.07) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(var(--fgc),.07) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:52px 52px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#000 25%,transparent 75%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#000 25%,transparent 75%)}
body.grid .gridbg{display:block}
body.no-glow .glow{display:none}
.logo svg{transform:translate(calc(var(--px,0)*14px),calc(var(--py,0)*14px));transition:transform .3s ease-out}
.fv{position:relative}
.ld{position:absolute;left:0;top:70px;width:35%;height:2px;z-index:3;background:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--fg);animation:ldm 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ldm{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:translateX(300%)}}
.fbar .btn+.btn{margin-left:0}
.m pre{margin:10px 0;padding:14px;overflow:auto;background:rgba(var(--fgc),.07);border:1px solid var(--line);font:.85rem/1.6 var(--mono);white-space:pre}
.m code{font-family:var(--mono);background:rgba(var(--fgc),.1);padding:1px 5px}
.m pre code{background:none;padding:0}
.pop .clr{align-self:flex-start}
.volr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;font:.75rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim)}
.vol{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;height:3px;background:rgba(var(--fgc),.25);cursor:pointer}
.vol::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--fg)}
.vol::-moz-range-thumb{width:13px;height:13px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--fg)}
.clock{position:fixed;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 16px);right:18px;z-index:5;text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;font:.72rem var(--mono);color:var(--dim);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .9s .7s}
body.entered .clock{opacity:1}
body.no-clock .clock{display:none}
.clock b{font:800 1.7rem/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.05em;color:var(--fg)}
.clock i{font-style:normal;opacity:.6}
@media (hover:none){.clock i{display:none}}
.pal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding-top:16vh;background:rgba(0,0,0,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s}
.pal.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.pbox{width:min(92vw,560px);background:#000;border:1px solid var(--fg);box-shadow:0 0 90px rgba(var(--fgc),.16);transform:translateY(-14px);transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.pal.open .pbox{transform:none}
.pbox input{display:block;width:100%;height:62px;padding:0 20px;font:600 1.1rem var(--display);letter-spacing:-.02em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.plist{max-height:50vh;overflow:auto}
.pi{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:14px 20px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--fg);font:.9rem var(--mono);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.pi.on,.pi:hover{background:var(--fg);color:#000}
.pi small{opacity:.55}
.ib.sh.on{background:rgba(var(--fgc),.18);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--fg)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,20px);opacity:0;background:var(--fg);color:#000;padding:12px 18px;font:.85rem var(--mono);z-index:30;max-width:90vw;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .brand,.view,.vb>*,.m{transition-duration:.01s;animation:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .star,.ring1,.ring2,.pulse,.title span::before,.title span::after,.prompt b{animation:none}
}
/* v2 glow-up */
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-25%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(38vmax circle at 18% 22%,rgba(var(--fgc),.13),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(34vmax circle at 82% 78%,rgba(var(--fgc),.09),transparent 60%);animation:drift 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate(6%,-5%) rotate(8deg) scale(1.1)}}
.tile{background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(var(--fgc),.1),rgba(0,0,0,.6) 60%);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.menu.live .tile:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.02)}
.card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(var(--fgc),.07),rgba(var(--fgc),.015));transition:border-color .25s,transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),box-shadow .35s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 18px 50px -20px rgba(var(--fgc),.5)}
.mv{max-width:1100px}
.mv .card{min-height:260px;padding:16px;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body::before{animation:none}}
/* video background: hidden until the intro is done, tinted by Ink */
.bgv{position:fixed;inset:-4%;width:108%;height:108%;object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;filter:brightness(calc(1 - var(--vd,.5))) contrast(1.1);transform:translate(calc(var(--px,0)*-18px),calc(var(--py,0)*-18px));transition:opacity 2.2s .9s ease-out,transform .5s ease-out}
.bgt{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:rgb(var(--fgc));mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:0;transition:opacity 2.2s .9s ease-out}
body.entered .bgv,body.entered .bgt{opacity:1}
body.no-vid .bgv,body.no-vid .bgt{display:none}
</style>
</head>

<script>
(function(){
  var logo=document.getElementById('logo'), stage=document.getElementById('stage'), menu=document.getElementById('menu'), brand=document.querySelector('.brand');
  var entered=false, START=.26, END=.11, END_SCALE=.5, reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  function enter(){
    if(entered) return; entered=true;
    document.body.classList.add('entered');
    var D=innerHeight*(START-END), amp=Math.max(D/2,60), dur=(reduce||S.skip)?1:1500, t0=performance.now();
    function step(now){
      var t=Math.min((now-t0)/dur,1);
      var e=t<.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;
      var phi=Math.PI*e;
      var x=amp*Math.sin(phi), y=-D*(1-Math.cos(phi))/2, r=28*Math.sin(phi), s=1-(1-END_SCALE)*e;
      logo.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) translate('+x+'px,'+y+'px) rotate('+r+'deg) scale('+s+')';
      if(t<1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else { brand.classList.add('live'); setTimeout(function(){ menu.classList.add('live'); },300); }
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  stage.addEventListener('click',enter);
  stage.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();enter();} });

  // ---- settings: fill these in ----
  var CFG={
    wisp:['wss://angler-creole-clock.ngrok-free.dev/','wss://angler-creole-clock.ngrok-free.dev/wisp/','wss://wisp-server-python-1-nljh.onrender.com/'],
    movies:'https://www.movy.sx/',
    games:[{n:'GN Math',u:''},{n:'Truffled',u:''},{n:'UGS',u:''},{n:'CKV',u:''},{n:'Seraph',u:''},{n:'GMShelf',u:''}],
    ai:{endpoint:'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions',model:'openrouter/auto'},
    music:[], // [{t:'Title',a:'Artist',u:'https://example.com/song.mp3'}] (the host must allow CORS)
    ytdlp:'', // your yt-dlp server: GET ?q=... returns {title,artist,url} (url must be a CORS-enabled audio stream)
    discord:'',
    proxySite:'https://www.croxyproxy.com/', // proxy site used by the Proxy page (add {url} if the site accepts the address in its link)
    encode:null // set to function(url){ return '/service/'+... } once Scramjet or Ultraviolet is installed
  };

  // ---- views ----
  var view=document.getElementById('view'), vb=document.getElementById('vb'), vt=document.getElementById('vt'), back=document.getElementById('back'), toastEl=document.getElementById('toast'), stack=[], tt;
  var vs=document.getElementById('vs');
  function T(s,o){ o=o||{}; hero=null; vt.textContent=''; vt.setAttribute('aria-label',s); Array.prototype.forEach.call(s,function(ch,i){ var sp=document.createElement('span'); sp.textContent=ch; sp.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); sp.style.animationDelay=(.3+i*.06)+'s'; vt.appendChild(sp); }); vs.textContent=o.sub||''; view.classList.toggle('frame',!!o.frame); view.classList.toggle('compact',!!o.compact); }

  function aiView(){

    }

        var r=await fetch(CFG.ai.endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+k.value.trim(),'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Title':'Larp.lol'},body:JSON.stringify({model:mo.value.trim()||CFG.ai.model,messages:hist,stream:true})});

        }

      m.classList.remove('live'); busy=false;
    };
    vb.replaceChildren(d);
  }

    var W=[].concat(CFG.wisp), wi=0;

      if(wi>=W.length) return fin(false);

    function go(v){
      v=v.trim(); if(!v) return; addRec(v);
      var url=/^[a-z]+:\/\//i.test(v)?v:(/^[\w-]+(\.[\w-]+)+(\/.*)?$/.test(v)?'https://'+v:'https://duckduckgo.com/?q='+encodeURIComponent(v));
      if(!CFG.encode){
        if(CFG.proxySite){ if(CFG.proxySite.indexOf('{url}')<0){ try{ navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function(){ toast('Address copied. Paste it into the box.'); },function(){}); }catch(e){} } window.open(CFG.proxySite.indexOf('{url}')<0?CFG.proxySite:CFG.proxySite.replace('{url}',encodeURIComponent(url)),'_blank','noopener'); return; }

  var TRACKS=[

    {t:'Glass Hours',a:'Larp Radio',g:{bpm:68,root:50,sc:[0,2,3,7,10],ch:[[0,3,7,10],[-4,0,3,7],[-7,-4,0,3],[-2,2,5,8]]}},

  var dock=el('<button class="ring" aria-label="Player"><span class="disc"><i class="hole"></i></span></button><div class="dinfo"><b></b><span></span></div><div class="eq"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><div class="dctl"><button class="ib" data-a="prev" aria-label="Previous">'+ICON.prev+'</button><button class="ib pp" data-a="pp" aria-label="Play or pause"></button><button class="ib" data-a="next" aria-label="Next">'+ICON.next+'</button></div><button class="ib" data-a="open" aria-label="Open music">'+ICON.full+'</button><button class="ib" data-a="min" aria-label="Collapse player">'+ICON.chev+'</button>','dock');

  dock.addEventListener('click',function(e){

  function renderList(){

    P.list.forEach(function(t,i){
      var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='tr'+(i===P.i?' on':''); b.style.setProperty('--i',i); b.innerHTML='<span class="th"></span><span class="tx"><b></b><small></small></span><em></em>';
      b.querySelector('.th').style.backgroundImage=art(t.seed); b.querySelector('b').textContent=t.t; b.querySelector('small').textContent=t.a; b.querySelector('em').textContent=t.g?fmt(t.dur):'file'; b.onclick=function(){ play(i); }; hero.list.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  // ---- music sources + footer ----
  function spot(e){ var c=e.target.closest('.card'); if(!c) return; var r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); c.style.setProperty('--mx',(e.clientX-r.left)+'px'); c.style.setProperty('--my',(e.clientY-r.top)+'px'); }
  function srcFrame(t,u){ musicOpen=false; syncDock(); frameView(t,u,musicView); }
  function searchView(t,sub,ph,go){
    stack.push(musicView); T(t,{sub:sub});
    var d=el('<div class="launch"><form class="search"><input autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"><button class="go" aria-label="Search">'+ARROW+'</button></form></div>','proxy'), i=d.querySelector('input');
    i.placeholder=ph; i.setAttribute('aria-label',ph);
    d.querySelector('form').onsubmit=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var q=i.value.trim(); if(q) go(q); };
    vb.replaceChildren(d); setTimeout(function(){ i.focus({preventScroll:true}); },700);
  }
  function ytdlp(q){
    if(!CFG.ytdlp){ toast('Set CFG.ytdlp to your yt-dlp server to use this source.'); return; }
    toast('Searching SoundCloud...');
    fetch(CFG.ytdlp+(CFG.ytdlp.indexOf('?')<0?'?':'&')+'q='+encodeURIComponent(q)).then(function(r){ if(!r.ok) throw 0; return r.json(); }).then(function(j){
      var a=[].concat(j).filter(function(x){ return x&&x.url; }); if(!a.length) throw 0;
      var first=P.list.length; a.forEach(function(x){ P.list.push({t:x.title||q,a:x.artist||'SoundCloud',u:x.url,seed:hash(x.title||q)}); });
      play(first); if(stack.length) stack.pop()();
    }).catch(function(){ toast('The yt-dlp server did not return a track.'); });
  }
  var SRC=[
    ['YouTube Music','Stream',function(){ srcFrame('YouTube Music','https://music.youtube.com/'); }],
    ['Tidal','Search',function(){ searchView('Tidal','Search for a song or artist.','Search Tidal',function(q){ srcFrame('Tidal','https://listen.tidal.com/search?q='+encodeURIComponent(q)); }); }],
    ['SoundCloud (yt-dlp)','Search and play',function(){ searchView('SoundCloud','Search or paste a link.','Search SoundCloud',ytdlp); }],
    ['SoundCloud','Browse',function(){ srcFrame('SoundCloud','https://soundcloud.com/'); }]
  ];
  function buildSrc(c){
    SRC.forEach(function(s,i){ var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='card'; b.style.setProperty('--i',i); b.innerHTML='<span class="arr">'+ARROW+'</span><span class="nm"></span><span class="tag"></span>'; b.querySelector('.nm').textContent=s[0]; b.querySelector('.tag').textContent=s[1]; b.onclick=s[2]; c.appendChild(b); });
    c.addEventListener('pointermove',spot);
  }
  document.getElementById('ab').onclick=function(){
    var w=window.open('about:blank','_blank'); if(!w){ toast('Allow pop-ups to open in about:blank.'); return; }
    try{ w.document.title=document.title; w.document.body.style.cssText='margin:0;height:100vh;background:#000'; var f=w.document.createElement('iframe'); f.src=location.href; f.style.cssText='border:0;width:100%;height:100%'; w.document.body.appendChild(f); }
    catch(e){ w.close(); toast('Could not open about:blank.'); }
  };
  document.getElementById('dc').onclick=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); if(CFG.discord) window.open(CFG.discord,'_blank','noopener'); else toast('Discord is coming soon.'); };

  function musicView(){
    T('Music',{compact:1}); musicOpen=true;
    var d=el('<section class="hero"><div class="vis"><canvas></canvas><div class="bigdisc"><i class="hole"></i></div></div><h3 class="mt"></h3><p class="ma"></p><div class="seek"><span class="tc">0:00</span><div class="sbar"><b><i></i></b></div><span class="te">0:00</span></div><div class="bctl"><button class="ib" data-a="prev" aria-label="Previous">'+ICON.prev+'</button><button class="ib pp" data-a="pp" aria-label="Play or pause"></button><button class="ib" data-a="next" aria-label="Next">'+ICON.next+'</button><button class="ib sh" data-a="shuf" aria-label="Shuffle">'+ICON.shuf+'</button></div><div class="volr"><span>Vol</span><input class="vol" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" aria-label="Volume"></div></section><section><div class="lh"><span>Sources</span></div><div class="src"></div><div class="lh"><span>Library</span><label class="btn solid">Add your music<input type="file" accept="audio/*" multiple hidden></label></div><div class="tl"></div></section>','mus');
    var $=function(s){ return d.querySelector(s); };
    hero={cv:$('canvas'),disc:$('.bigdisc'),t:$('.mt'),a:$('.ma'),pp:$('.pp'),list:$('.tl'),fill:$('.sbar b'),tc:$('.tc'),te:$('.te'),sm:[]};
    d.addEventListener('click',function(e){ var b=e.target.closest('button[data-a]'); if(b) act(b.dataset.a); });
    var vl=$('.vol'); vl.value=VOL; vl.oninput=function(){ VOL=+vl.value; if(vg) vg.gain.value=VOL; store('larp.vol',VOL); }; if(P.shuf) $('.sh').classList.add('on');
    $('.sbar').onclick=function(e){ var t=cur(); if(!t||t.g||!aud.duration) return; var r=this.getBoundingClientRect(); aud.currentTime=aud.duration*Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)); };
    $('input').onchange=function(){ var f=this.files, first=P.list.length; [].forEach.call(f,function(x){ P.list.push({t:x.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,''),a:'Your files',u:URL.createObjectURL(x),seed:hash(x.name)}); }); renderList(); if(f.length) play(first); };
    buildSrc($('.src')); vb.replaceChildren(d); renderList(); ui();
  }
  function vis(cv,t,pl){
    var w=cv.clientWidth; if(!w) return; var dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2), px=Math.round(w*dpr); if(cv.width!==px) cv.width=cv.height=px;
    var x=cv.getContext('2d'), N=72, r0=w*.27+8, mx=w*.2, sm=hero.sm; x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0); x.clearRect(0,0,w,w);
    x.strokeStyle='rgb('+INK+')'; x.lineWidth=Math.max(2,w*.008); x.lineCap='round';
    x.globalAlpha=.25; x.beginPath(); x.arc(w/2,w/2,r0-5,0,6.2832); x.stroke(); x.globalAlpha=1;
    for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
      var k=i<N/2?i:N-1-i, v=pl?data[Math.floor(k*1.6)]/255:.03+.02*Math.sin(t*1.5+i*.4); sm[i]=(sm[i]||0)+(v-(sm[i]||0))*.3;
      var a=i/N*6.2832-1.5708, c=Math.cos(a), s=Math.sin(a), l=3+sm[i]*mx;
      x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(w/2+c*r0,w/2+s*r0); x.lineTo(w/2+c*(r0+l),w/2+s*(r0+l)); x.stroke();
    }
  }
  function tick(now){
    requestAnimationFrame(tick); var pl=P.playing&&an;
    if(pl) an.getByteFrequencyData(data);
    var pp=pd(), p=pp[1]?Math.min(1,pp[0]/pp[1]):0;
    ringEl.style.setProperty('--p',p*100);
    [1,4,9,16].forEach(function(k,i){ eqs[i].style.height=(3+19*(pl?data[k]/255:0))+'px'; });
    if(hero){ hero.fill.style.setProperty('--p',p*100); hero.tc.textContent=fmt(pp[0]); hero.te.textContent=fmt(pp[1]); vis(hero.cv,now/1000,pl); }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  if('mediaSession' in navigator){ [['play',toggle],['pause',toggle],['nexttrack',next],['previoustrack',prev]].forEach(function(h){ try{ navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler(h[0],h[1]); }catch(e){} }); }
  menu.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){ var c=e.target.closest('.tile'); if(!c) return; var r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); c.style.setProperty('--mx',(e.clientX-r.left)+'px'); c.style.setProperty('--my',(e.clientY-r.top)+'px'); });

  // ---- polish: glow, parallax, keyboard ----
  var gx=0, gy=0, gq=false;
  addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){ gx=e.clientX; gy=e.clientY; if(gq) return; gq=true; requestAnimationFrame(function(){ gq=false; var r=document.documentElement.style; r.setProperty('--gx',gx+'px'); r.setProperty('--gy',gy+'px'); r.setProperty('--px',(gx/innerWidth-.5).toFixed(3)); r.setProperty('--py',(gy/innerHeight-.5).toFixed(3)); }); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    var tg=e.target&&e.target.tagName; if(/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(tg)||e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey||e.altKey) return;
    if(e.key===' '&&P.i>=0&&tg!=='BUTTON'&&tg!=='A'){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); return; }
    if(/^[1-6]$/.test(e.key)&&entered&&menu.classList.contains('live')&&!view.classList.contains('open')){ var b=menu.querySelectorAll('.tile')[+e.key-1]; if(b) openView(b.dataset.go,b); }
  });
  function esc(t){ return t.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>'); }
  function md(t){ return t.split('```').map(function(x,i){ return i%2?'<pre><code>'+esc(x.replace(/^[^\n]*\n/,''))+'</code></pre>':esc(x).replace(/`([^`\n]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>').replace(/\*\*([^*\n]+)\*\*/g,'<b>$1</b>'); }).join(''); }

  // ---- clock + command palette ----
  var clk=el('<b></b><span></span><i>Press Ctrl K</i>','clock'); document.body.appendChild(clk);
  function tickClock(){ var d=new Date(); clk.querySelector('b').textContent=d.toLocaleTimeString([],{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'}); clk.querySelector('span').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString([],{weekday:'long',month:'short',day:'numeric'}); }
  tickClock(); setInterval(tickClock,10000);
  var pal=el('<div class="pbox"><input placeholder="Type a command or a link" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Command"><div class="plist"></div></div>','pal'), pin=pal.querySelector('input'), plist=pal.querySelector('.plist'), pc=0, pitems=[];
  document.body.appendChild(pal);
  var CMDS=[['Open Proxy','proxy','1'],['Open Games','games','2'],['Open Movies','movies','3'],['Open Ai','ai','4'],['Open Music','music','5'],['Open Settings','settings','6'],['Play or pause',toggle,''],['Next track',next,''],['Previous track',prev,''],['Open in about:blank',function(){ document.getElementById('ab').click(); },'']];
  function palRender(){
    var raw=pin.value.trim(), q=raw.toLowerCase();
    pitems=CMDS.filter(function(c){ return c[0].toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1; });
    if(raw) pitems.push(['Browse “'+raw+'” in Proxy',function(){ openView('proxy'); var f=vb.querySelector('.search'); f.querySelector('input').value=raw; f.requestSubmit(); },'']);
    pc=Math.max(0,Math.min(pc,pitems.length-1)); plist.textContent='';
    pitems.forEach(function(c,i){ var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='pi'+(i===pc?' on':''); b.innerHTML='<span></span><small></small>'; b.firstChild.textContent=c[0]; b.lastChild.textContent=c[2]; b.onclick=function(){ palRun(c); }; plist.appendChild(b); });
  }
  function palRun(c){ palClose(); if(typeof c[1]==='string') openView(c[1]); else c[1](); }
  function palOpen(){ if(!entered) return; pin.value=''; pc=0; palRender(); pal.classList.add('open'); setTimeout(function(){ pin.focus(); },30); }
  function palClose(){ pal.classList.remove('open'); pin.blur(); }
  pin.addEventListener('input',function(){ pc=0; palRender(); });
  pin.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){ e.preventDefault(); if(pitems.length){ pc=(pc+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+pitems.length)%pitems.length; palRender(); } }
    else if(e.key==='Enter'){ e.preventDefault(); if(pitems[pc]) palRun(pitems[pc]); }
    else if(e.key==='Escape'){ e.stopPropagation(); palClose(); }
  });
  pal.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target===pal) palClose(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='k'){ e.preventDefault(); if(pal.classList.contains('open')) palClose(); else palOpen(); } });
  if(S.skip) setTimeout(enter,30);

  // ---- v2: arcade, movies, music search, cloak, leave warning ----
  CFG.decoy=CFG.decoy||'https://classroom.google.com/';
  function go(u){ try{ top.location.replace(u); }catch(e){ location.replace(u); } }
  var HOME=location.href; if(HOME==='about:srcdoc'){ try{ HOME=parent.location.href; }catch(e){} }
  Object.assign(DEF,{warn:1,cloak:'',panic:'`',vid:1,vdim:.5}); for(var dk in DEF) if(S[dk]===undefined) S[dk]=DEF[dk];
  var bypass=false, ico=document.querySelector('link[rel=icon]'), ico0=ico.href;
  var CL={c:['Google Classroom','https://ssl.gstatic.com/classroom/favicon.png'],d:['My Drive - Google Drive','https://ssl.gstatic.com/docs/doclist/images/drive_2022q3_32dp.png'],g:['Untitled document - Google Docs','https://ssl.gstatic.com/docs/documents/images/kix-favicon7.ico']};
  function cloak(){ var c=CL[S.cloak]; document.title=c?c[0]:'Larp.lol'; try{ parent.document.title=document.title; }catch(e){} ico.type=c?'':'image/svg+xml'; ico.href=c?c[1]:ico0; }
  cloak();
  addEventListener('beforeunload',function(e){ if(S.warn&&!bypass){ e.preventDefault(); e.returnValue=''; return ''; } });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(S.panic&&e.key===S.panic&&!/INPUT|TEXTAREA/.test(e.target.tagName)){ bypass=true; go(CFG.decoy); } });
  var abBtn=document.getElementById('ab'); if(top!==self&&location.href!=='about:srcdoc') abBtn.hidden=true;
  abBtn.onclick=function(){
    var w=window.open('about:blank','_blank'); if(!w){ toast('Allow pop-ups, then try again.'); return; }
    try{ var D=w.document; D.title=CL[S.cloak]?CL[S.cloak][0]:'Larp.lol'; D.body.style.cssText='margin:0;height:100vh;background:#000'; var f=D.createElement('iframe'); f.src=HOME; f.allow='fullscreen; autoplay'; f.style.cssText='border:0;width:100%;height:100%'; D.body.appendChild(f); }
    catch(err){ w.close(); toast('Could not open about:blank.'); return; }
    bypass=true; try{ top.close(); }catch(err){} setTimeout(function(){ go(CFG.decoy); },150);
  };
  var _sv=settingsView; settingsView=function(){
    _sv(); var d=vb.firstChild, n=9;
    function row(l,s){ var r=el('<div><b></b><small></small></div><div class="rc"></div>','opt'); r.style.setProperty('--i',n++); r.querySelector('b').textContent=l; r.querySelector('small').textContent=s; d.insertBefore(r,d.lastChild); return r.querySelector('.rc'); }
    function seg(c,k,o){ o.forEach(function(x){ var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='sg'+(S[k]===x[1]?' on':''); b.textContent=x[0]; b.onclick=function(){ S[k]=x[1]; applySet(); cloak(); vidApply(); [].forEach.call(c.children,function(y){ y.classList.toggle('on',y===b); }); }; c.appendChild(b); }); }
    seg(row('Tab cloak','Disguise the tab title and icon'),'cloak',[['Off',''],['Classroom','c'],['Drive','d'],['Docs','g']]);
    seg(row('Panic key','Jump to a decoy site instantly'),'panic',[['Off',''],['`','`'],['\\','\\']]);
    function tog(l,s,k){ var c=row(l,s), b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='sw'; b.setAttribute('role','switch'); b.setAttribute('aria-label',l); b.setAttribute('aria-checked',!!S[k]); b.onclick=function(){ S[k]=S[k]?0:1; b.setAttribute('aria-checked',!!S[k]); applySet(); vidApply(); }; c.appendChild(b); }
    seg(row('Video dim','How dark the video background is'),'vdim',[['Light',.3],['Medium',.5],['Dark',.7]]);
    tog('Video background','Fades in after the intro','vid'); tog('Leave warning','Your browser asks before you close or leave','warn');
  };

  function jsonp(u,cb){ var f='j'+Date.now()+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6), s=document.createElement('script'); window[f]=function(j){ s.remove(); delete window[f]; cb(j); }; s.onerror=function(){ s.remove(); cb(null); }; s.src=u+'&callback='+f; document.head.appendChild(s); }
  function moviesView(){
    T('Movies',{compact:1});
    var d=el('<div class="launch"><form class="search"><input placeholder="Search free movies" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Search movies"><button class="go" aria-label="Search">'+ARROW+'</button></form></div><div class="grid mv"></div>','proxy'), g=d.querySelector('.mv'), i=d.querySelector('input');
    function load(q){
      g.textContent='Loading…';
      jsonp('https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q='+encodeURIComponent('mediatype:movies AND collection:feature_films'+(q?' AND ('+q+')':''))+'&fl[]=identifier&fl[]=title&sort[]=downloads+desc&rows=24&output=json',function(j){
        var a=j&&j.response&&j.response.docs; g.textContent=''; if(!a||!a.length){ g.textContent=j?'No results.':'Could not reach the movie library.'; return; }
        a.forEach(function(m,n){ var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='card'; b.style.setProperty('--i',n%8); b.style.backgroundImage='linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 30%,#000),url(https://archive.org/services/img/'+m.identifier+')'; b.innerHTML='<span class="arr">'+ARROW+'</span><span class="nm"></span>'; b.querySelector('.nm').textContent=m.title; b.querySelector('.nm').style.fontSize='1.05rem'; b.onclick=function(){ frameView(m.title,'https://archive.org/embed/'+m.identifier,moviesView); }; g.appendChild(b); });
      });
    }
    d.querySelector('form').onsubmit=function(e){ e.preventDefault(); load(i.value.replace(/[()]/g,'').trim()); };
    g.addEventListener('pointermove',spot); vb.replaceChildren(d); load('');
  }
  function msearch(q){
    toast('Searching…');
    jsonp('https://itunes.apple.com/search?media=music&entity=song&limit=25&term='+encodeURIComponent(q),function(j){
      var a=((j&&j.results)||[]).filter(function(x){ return x.previewUrl; }); if(!a.length) return toast(j?'No songs found.':'Search failed.');
      var f=P.list.length; a.forEach(function(x){ P.list.push({t:x.trackName,a:x.artistName,u:x.previewUrl,seed:hash(x.trackName+x.artistName)}); });
      play(f); if(stack.length) stack.pop()();
    });
  }
  SRC.unshift(['Search songs','30-second previews',function(){ searchView('Songs','Search any song or artist.','Search songs',msearch); }]);

  var bgv=document.getElementById('bgv');
  function vidApply(){ document.body.classList.toggle('no-vid',!S.vid); bgv.style.setProperty('--vd',S.vdim); if(S.vid&&!reduce) bgv.play().catch(function(){}); else bgv.pause(); }
  vidApply(); stage.addEventListener('click',function(){ if(S.vid&&!reduce) bgv.play().catch(function(){}); });

  var R={proxy:proxyView,games:gamesView,ai:aiView,music:musicView,settings:settingsView,movies:moviesView};
  function openView(r,b){ stack=[]; var rc=b?b.getBoundingClientRect():{left:innerWidth/2,top:innerHeight/2,width:0,height:0}; view.style.setProperty('--cx',(rc.left+rc.width/2)+'px'); view.style.setProperty('--cy',(rc.top+rc.height/2)+'px'); musicOpen=(r==='music'); menu.classList.add('away'); view.classList.add('open'); view.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); R[r](); syncDock(); back.focus({preventScroll:true}); }
  function closeView(){ musicOpen=false; syncDock(); view.classList.remove('open'); view.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); menu.classList.remove('away'); setTimeout(function(){ if(!view.classList.contains('open')) vb.replaceChildren(); },700); }
  back.addEventListener('click',function(){ if(stack.length) stack.pop()(); else closeView(); });
  menu.addEventListener('click',function(e){ var b=e.target.closest('button[data-go]'); if(b) openView(b.dataset.go,b); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape'&&view.classList.contains('open')) back.click(); });

  // drifting star field
  var c=document.getElementById('stars'), g=c.getContext('2d'), P=[], W,H,dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  function size(){W=c.width=innerWidth*dpr;H=c.height=innerHeight*dpr;}
  size(); addEventListener('resize',size);
  for(var i=0;i<80;i++) P.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),r:Math.random()*1.3+.3,v:Math.random()*.00006+.00002,a:Math.random()*.5+.15});
  function draw(){
    g.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    for(var i=0;i<P.length;i++){
      var p=P[i]; p.y-=p.v; if(p.y<0){p.y=1;p.x=Math.random();}
      g.fillStyle='rgba('+INK+','+p.a+')';
      g.fillRect(p.x*W,p.y*H,p.r*dpr,p.r*dpr);
    }
    if(!reduce) requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  draw();
})();
</script>
</body>
